lines: The clay pits gave up their bones to us. We look after them now.
Every fossil was alive once. Remember that when you dig.
npcs.name: Silas

trainer.name: Silas
wait: Nobody skips the dig crew. Not even you.
Pass all three, then bring me what you have found.
say: Welcome to the kiln hall. Mind the trenches, we are still digging.
My Pokemon walked Kenora long before there were roads.
Old does not mean slow. Let me show you.
say2: Back already? The trenches are deeper since you left. Let us go.
lose: Well dug. You found something in that battle I had not seen in years.
The Claystone Badge is yours. Polish it now and then.

lines: Shovelled under. Silas is at the back.
